scientific_choices.choice: Sections3.3/3.5 localize image text and route uncertain full images to DeepSolo. The new coverage gate and YOLO resolution ablations are external experiments, not paper-specified algorithms.

Reuse the pinned YOLOv8s TextOCR checkpoint, actual Ultralytics8.1.0 source, genuine PARSeq CPU FP32 crop recognizer, frozen CLIP B16 prompts and Text/Kernel U-Net probability exports. Read only the two predicted probability channels; no GT/validity/owners may enter coverage features. Crops use original stored RGB pixels.

Measure weighted foreground coverage by the union of final exclusive word rectangles in the original U-Net center-letterbox256 frame, separately for Text and Kernel at probability0.5; record uncovered components of at least4 pixels. Empty masks are neutral; empty OCR cannot be accepted.

Fit CLIP/native CDF references on the original TRAIN80 calibration IDs. Select coverage field and mixture weight by micro F1 on those80 images at exactly50% bypass; break ties in favor of confidence-only. Keep the other45 TRAIN images separate and never select using TEST correctness.

Preserve considerable bypass through explicit GT-free batch rank budgets30/50/70%; primary50%. Also transfer scalar TRAIN thresholds and report actual coverage separately, because a scalar threshold cannot guarantee the same TEST bypass fraction.

A paired640 coverage-only change preserves all frozen detector/OCR/CLIP outputs. Reuse audited960 TEST detector/OCR caches, obtain missing960 TRAIN and1280 TRAIN/TEST outputs, retaining joint0.6 and same-reading NMS0.5. Detector floor0.35 lies below the necessary0.36 joint-confidence bound. Record old CPU detector versus new CUDA detection provenance; do not attribute all differences to resolution alone.

Existing isolated YOLO environment on RTX3090; CUDA FP32 batch1 YOLO, CPU FP32 PARSeq batch32, then unload detector/OCR before CUDA CLIP batch16. Record shapes, actual allocated/reserved peaks, co-resident processes and failures; no installation, mixed precision or silent CPU fallback.

An imperfect U-Net can miss text or mark background; coverage is evidence, not a guarantee of complete recognition. TEST has already been explored historically, so this is approximate exploratory validation. Official paper metric/checkpoint mapping, target3070 qualification and strict reproduction remain unresolved.
